response.original_title: Andrew Liles: Ouarda (The Subtle Art Of Phyllorhodomancy)
response.overview: Hybrid DualDisc version of Andrew Liles' "Ouarda (The Subtle Art Of Phyllorhodomancy)". The DVD side has a film by Michael Tang with musical adaptations by Colin Potter, "Old Tom's Marrow" (a film by Liles) and three 5.1 mixes by Freida Abtan. It came in a super jewel-box with an 8-page full-colour booklet, and the DVD is NTSC all-region.
